name: InlineSubscribe
title: InlineSubscribe
summary: A single-row newsletter sign-up: a 52px pill email field and a Subscribe pill button that wrap onto two lines on narrow screens, for light and dark sections.
whenToUse: Inline email capture inside a section, footer or article end: the ISM newsletter, prayer updates, ISM Radio programme news.
Only an email is needed. If you also need a name, topics or a heading block, use NewsletterCard or a FormLayout.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for search (SearchField) or for sign-in.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed email once it passes validation. Return a promise to show the sending state. No network code is included.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder, an example and never the label.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Submit button text; it is the consent action, for example "Subscribe".

props.name: note
props.description: Reassurance line (frequency, unsubscribe) shown under the row while there is no error.

props.name: emptyError
props.description: Message when the field is empty on submit, for example "Please enter your email address."

props.name: invalidError
props.description: Message when the email is malformed, for example "Enter a valid email, like name@example.com."

props.name: successMessage
props.description: Text of the success state that replaces the form, for example "You're in. Watch for our next letter."

props.name: error
props.description: Externally supplied error (for example from the server). Overrides internal validation text.

props.name: done
props.description: Show the success state (controlled). When omitted the component switches itself after a successful submit.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the sending spinner and set `aria-disabled` on the button (controlled).

variantNotes: Light: white field with the base border on `--off-white` or white.
Dark (inside `.on-dark` or `.sec-ink`): field turns `rgba(255,255,255,.06)` with a 30% white border and white text; placeholder `--text-tertiary-dark`; the note uses `--text-tertiary-dark`.
Focus: the base `--horizon-blue` border and `--shadow-focus` on both backgrounds.
Error: `aria-invalid="true"` on the input and an `.err.fm-sub-err` line under the row. On dark the border and text use `--error-on-dark`.
Success: the form is replaced by `.fm-sub-done`, a 52px pill with a tick: `--success` on `--success-bg` on light, `--success-on-dark` on a translucent fill on dark.
Sending: the button shows `.spin` and is `aria-disabled="true"` until the request returns.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: One field, one button. The button is the one Horizon Blue primary in its group; do not add a second blue button beside it.
Always use `type="email"` and `autocomplete="email"`; validate on submit, then live once an error is showing.
Keep the field and button the same 52px height and pill shape; never square the corners.
Put the success message where the form was, so the layout does not jump; keep it until the page is left.
Never pre-tick or hide marketing consent; the button label is the consent action ("Subscribe").
Give the reassurance line (frequency, unsubscribe) next to the form, not in a tooltip.
On phones the button drops below the field at full width; both stay 52px tall.

accessibility: Visually hidden label "Email address" tied to the input with `for`.
The note and the error are linked with `aria-describedby`; switch it to the error id when invalid.
Success uses `role="status"`; move focus to it only if the form had focus.
Error and success are carried by text and icon, not colour alone.
`--error-on-dark` and `--success-on-dark` keep contrast on black; never use `--error` text on dark.
content: Note: "Stories from the field, once a month. Unsubscribe anytime."
Errors: "Please enter your email address." / "Enter a valid email, like name@example.com."
Success: "You're in. Watch for our next letter."
